integrity: The 2026 primary full text was inspected at the class definition, both main theorems, and the proof of the logarithmic-coefficient bound. The exact threshold was reconstructed by conformal normalization to G_c(w)=1/w-c log|w|, direct Jacobian and Beltrami computation, and a nested-image-circle proof of global univalence. The exterior reciprocal extension attains the internal essential Beltrami norm, proving optimality rather than merely sufficiency.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact classification only for the natural pure logarithmic subfamily with vanishing regular analytic and coanalytic parts. It does not determine the optimal logarithmic coefficient in the full class. The full 1987 Hengartner--Schober article was not available in the full-text sources inspected, leaving a limited residual originality risk for an older equivalent observation.
title: Exact quasiconformal threshold for the pure logarithmic pole family
